patterns.digitizationNotes: Dimensioned stock sizes combined with the explicitly named and visually checked manufacturer pattern. Coordinates express the simple repeat, not pixels measured from an illustrative thumbnail. No undocumented joint allowance or nominal-size shrink is assumed. Add installation joints to pitch separately. Offset cells crossing the tile right edge must repeat/wrap into the adjoining tile; clipping without neighbouring repeats would leave a false gap.
